description: The Federated College of Engineers and Architects of Costa Rica (CFIA) publishes statistics of construction projects processed through its APC platform, the system through which building and civil works projects are registered before permitting. The statistics page read on 2026-09-28 (updated 27 August 2026) says CFIA compiles studies of the construction sector from the square metres processed over each period, offers Excel files for every year from 2014 to 2025 and for January to July 2026, and has updated the files with the number of levels per project, including basements, aggregated across the uses and sectors a project may span. Coverage is national. Access is free download; the page says the data are for statistical purposes only and CFIA assumes no responsibility for third-party use, and no licence is named. Caveats: processed projects are intentions to build, not completions, and the breakdown fields were not opened. It supports estimates of building stock growth for exposure models and capacity planning in Costa Rica. Related record: data-costa-rica-da-water-concessions-discharges-geoservices is another Costa Rican infrastructure source.
